limits: Includes the M50TU engine and A4S 310R gearbox cutaways, engine bay, suspension and body trim. Original geometry follows catalog drawings and installed references. Shapes, timing profiles, mounting locations and clearances are approximate. Check the installed part and catalog conditions before ordering. The brake hydraulics view shows the Girling booster and reservoir and a late ABS example. Mounting dimensions, line routing and clearance are approximate. Parking brake details show the drum-in-disc arrangement. Shoe dimensions and installed clearances are approximate. Front wiper arms and blades follow the late 525i windshield and catalog. Check your fitted blade adapter. Battery details follow the cited stock layout and catalog; case dimensions, cable routing and installed clearances remain illustrative. The trunk and rear-seat trim use the catalog layout and this model’s panel and seat anchors. Factory hole spacing and clearances are unmeasured. Front cabin fastener axes are aligned to the modeled seats and trim. Factory hole spacing, trim options and installed clearances have not been measured. Roof trim follows the existing model surfaces and catalog diagrams. Physical mounting positions and installed clearances have not been measured. Floor and restraint geometry follows the reference body and BMW catalog. Physical mounting dimensions and belt operation have not been measured. HVAC housings and duct routes are diagram-based. Confirm the fitted climate system before ordering. Physical dimensions and airflow have not been measured. The front chassis rails, firewall, inner sills, fuel pipes and wiring are fitted around the cabin. Their positions are modeled estimates.
